topic: Associated power plant capacity (background, not a terminal-capacity figure)
wiki_text: Sources give varying electrical ratings for the Wartsila dual-fuel power plant the terminal supplies (Antigua Power power station): 40 MW per APUA's official project page and an INOXCVA-featured trade article; 46 MW per Antigua Observer coverage; 47 MW per Antigua Newsroom/Pointville reporting. These figures describe the POWER PLANT's electrical rating, not the LNG terminal's regasification/storage throughput, and should not be used to fill the terminal's Capacity/CapacityUnits fields.
